info.title: Account #210 integration snapshot (unmerged backend)
info.description: Exact selected operations/schemas from backend #210. This snapshot is not the develop contract. Enable only with a compatible backend.

post.summary: Send the email verification link again
post.description: Keycloak emails a new verification link (valid 12 hours) when the address belongs to an account whose email is not verified yet. An unknown or already verified address gets the same 204 and no email, so the endpoint does not reveal which accounts exist. One email per address per minute, counted for unknown addresses too. Access: public (a supplied invalid bearer token is rejected). Ownership/business restriction: None.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit code to the phone on the profile. The code is valid for 5 minutes and is stored only as a salted SHA-256 hash; a newer code replaces older ones. At most 3 codes per 15 minutes. Locally the fake SMS sender writes the code to the log and to Mailpit (to <phone>@sms.nexus.local). Access: requires PROFILE.UPDATE. Ownership/business restriction: JWT subject only.

post.description: Checks the newest code sent for the current phone. A wrong code counts an attempt; after 5 wrong attempts the code is locked and a new one must be requested. A code sent before the phone changed no longer matches. Access: requires PROFILE.UPDATE. Ownership/business restriction: JWT subject only.
